entries.title: Grounded
entries.definitive_edition: Grounded: Fully Yoked Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original full-release route and the best high-end capture/settings path. The Fully Yoked update brought the same content to all supported platforms, so the PS5, Xbox Series X/S, PS4, Xbox One, and Switch versions are valid access routes without sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Fully Yoked build on Windows PC through Steam or Xbox/Microsoft Store. Use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S if a console route is preferred.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC full release with Fully Yoked content and scalable graphics/capture settings.
all_releases.reason: primary: original full-release route and best high-end capture/settings platform.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Xbox console release with Xbox Play Anywhere support.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete console route, but lower fidelity than Xbox Series X/S or high-end PC and no sourced exclusive content.

all_releases.fidelity: Current Xbox console release with Fully Yoked content and Xbox Play Anywhere support.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable Switch release of Grounded: Fully Yoked Edition.
all_releases.reason: skip: portable route only; no sourced exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: PlayStation 4 release of Grounded: Fully Yoked Edition.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete last-generation console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS5 release of Grounded: Fully Yoked Edition.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Fully Yoked update was released for all platforms and brought the same content across the platform set, so PC remains both complete and highest-fidelity.

entries.remaster_caveats: Fully Yoked is the final major content/update branding and multi-platform edition, not a separate sequel. Treat it as the definitive version of Grounded.

entries.title: Grounded 2
entries.definitive_edition: Grounded 2 on Windows PC, pending full 1.0 release

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Steam Early Access / Xbox Game Preview PC build
primary.why: Grounded 2 is still an Early Access/Game Preview title, and Windows PC is the most flexible current route through Steam or the Xbox app. Xbox Series X/S is a valid current console route and PS5 is announced for August 11, 2026, but neither has sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC Early Access build through Steam or the Xbox app/Game Pass. Re-check the recommendation when the game leaves Early Access.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC Early Access release through Steam and Xbox PC app.
all_releases.reason: primary: most flexible current route while the game is still in Early Access/Game Preview.

all_releases.fidelity: Xbox Game Preview console release on current Xbox hardware.
all_releases.reason: skip: valid console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC and less flexible capture/settings.

all_releases.fidelity: Announced PS5 Early Access release alongside the Into the Abyss update.
all_releases.reason: skip: future access route as of June 23, 2026; no sourced exclusive content over PC has been announced.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Grounded 2 is not yet complete on any platform; PC is the best current Early Access route rather than a final definitive edition.

entries.remaster_caveats: The game is still in Early Access/Game Preview. PS5 is an announced future Early Access route, not a remaster or separate game.
